literaryJudgment.sustainedStory: Malone narrates romantic vanity, newsroom errand, comic confrontation, investigation, forest journey, failed approaches, betrayal, captivity, rescues, war, escape and two distinct homecomings as actual events. No management lessons, invented exercises or replacement morals.
literaryJudgment.viewpoint: Challenger reports his prior journey; Malone learns of the capture from Roxton; the Macdona newspaper frame and Malone correction of the sanitised public report remain. No invented omniscient scene.
literaryJudgment.authorDifficulties: Fear, shame, ambition, bloodlust and pity remain distinct. Summerlee objects to war; Challenger celebrates conquest; massacre, enslavement and Malone discomfort remain in the story. Historical theories remain character-world claims.
literaryJudgment.causalLinks: Separate camp raids, Gomez motive, Roxton capture shot and later missed rescue shot, Maretas independent aid, failed balloon, missed fork, actual descent and later-arriving rescue remain connected.
literaryJudgment.ending: Public proof and specimen escape, uncertain later reports, Gladys already-completed marriage and the earlier chronology of the visit, diamond disclosure, equal shares and the offered hand remain. No certain specimen return/death or later expedition is invented.
literaryJudgment.shorterRoutes: Essential ends before ascent, Core at the camp mystery. Both honestly disclose unfinished-opening scope. The invitation/self-restraint promise now precedes the lecture in Essential.
literaryJudgment.depthDecision: 122 narrative paragraphs carry all16 chapters with sustained action, comedy, fear, changing trust and aftermath. Counts measure the resulting story; they are not a universal target.
